# TechPolarity

> TechPolarity is a technology news and insights platform covering AI, gadgets, software, gaming, and the products shaping how people live and work.

## About
- [About TechPolarity](https://www.techpolarity.com/about): Who we are and our mission.
- [Contact](https://www.techpolarity.com/contact): Get in touch with the team.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.techpolarity.com/privacy): How user data is handled.

## Content
- [Sitemap](https://www.techpolarity.com/sitemap.xml): Full, always-current list of categories, sections, and articles.
- Categories are available at `/category/{slug}`, sections at `/section/{slug}`, and individual articles at `/article/{slug}`.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers
- All article, category, and section pages are server-rendered HTML and safe to read directly from their URL.
- Search result pages (`/search`) are intentionally excluded from indexing and should not be cited as canonical sources.
- Each article page includes `NewsArticle` structured data (JSON-LD) with headline, description, publish date, and tags.
